brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished dozens of homes and facilities in Janba village in southeastern Hebron on Wednesday, forcibly displacing 176 civilians, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The operation destroyed residential, agricultural, and service structures across the community.

The PCHR condemned the demolitions as part of what it described as pursuit of West Bank annexation policies. The organization did not specify the stated Israeli justification for the operation or provide additional details on the scope of damage to agricultural and service infrastructure.
dek: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR) condemns in the strongest terms the Israeli Occupation Forces’ (IOF) widespread demolition of Janba village, in the far southeastern part of Hebron, yesterday, Wednesday. The IOF demolished dozens of homes and residential, agricultural, and service facilities, forcibly displacing dozens of families and depriving them of their homes, sources…
title: Israeli forces demolish Janba village, displace 176 civilians in Hebron
